authorization.source: Direct owner instruction to begin the first manuscript for Kindle and paperback

genre: Darkly comic System Apocalypse and civilization-building LitRPG
reader_promise: A lovable dog protagonist builds a safe home and a functioning pack while every caring upgrade quietly increases canine power over humans.
tone_arc: Sincere cozy domestic opening -> uncanny System discovery -> black-comic settlement building -> morally disturbing victory

chapter_plan.structure: Four acts; twelve source-derived story functions expanded into setup, choice and consequence

story_completion: Mriya founds and defends the first Pack Hearth and receives a provisional territory charter; the citywide canine awakening supplies sequel pull.

format_plan.kindle: Semantic chapter headings, reflowable paragraphs, accessible System notices, no print pagination or decorative dependency.
format_plan.paperback: Provisional 5.5 x 8.5 inch black-and-white cream-paper novel; final trim, page count, gutter, typography and price follow manuscript freeze.

source_boundary.owned_source: The user's Собакокалипсис essay supplies the world premise and escalation logic.
source_boundary.situation_source: The supplied ЧОРНАЯ file supplies abstract prompts only. No wording, characters, imagery sequence or verse expression may be copied.
source_boundary.transformation_rule: Every prompt becomes a new causal event with original characters, setting, mechanics, dialogue and outcome.

continuity_gates: Dog-limited close third-person point of view remains sensory and embodied.
Every stat increase changes a relationship, place or strategic option.
Cache, Bond, Pack, Territory and Adaptation rules remain consistent.
Settlement resources balance scarcity, tradeoffs and visible consequences.
The cozy opening is emotionally real rather than a disposable fakeout.
Care-versus-control theme escalates through choices rather than exposition.
editorial_gates: Character attachment to Mriya and Nika
Controlled repetition and varied sentence rhythm
Humor arising from dog logic and power inversion rather than constant gags
No machine-like summaries, generic filler or unexplained competence
No operational depiction of illegal trade methods
production_sequence: BookSpec, series bible, voice contract and 36-chapter outline
listing_policy: The existing package remains provisional. Final description, cover, categories, keywords and price follow owner approval of the edited manuscript.
ai_disclosure: KDP AI-generated-content disclosure will be required if the final manuscript substantially retains generated prose.
